method: Authenticated remote read-only comparison of existing five init3 action CSVs; no policy inference, replay, or training
evidence: Actions diverge at the first decision despite identical recorded 15D robot state and the same reported seed. State divergence follows at step1.
limits: The recorded robot state does not include pixels or object poses. Identical state is not identical full policy input. This cannot distinguish image/reset variation, policy loading/RNG differences, or GPU numerical nondeterminism; none is established as cause.
next_falsifiable_question: Are full first-observation pixels and post-load policy/RNG states identical across independent fixed-init3 evaluations? Register an instrumented bounded diagnostic before executing it.
choice: Prioritize full-input and RNG provenance diagnostic over additional training or task scaling.
